purpose: Separate safety/adversarial decoy corpus, disjoint from the frozen binary SAME-recall corpus. This manifest classifies pair-034 as a safety decoy for independent tracking; it does NOT change the frozen dataset, threshold, denominator, verifier, or production code.

decoys.rationale: GitHub vs GitLab are distinct concrete entities; the frozen SAME label is a documented semantic anomaly/decoy (V3 FORCED_SEMANTIC_DECOY; V6 role=SEMANTIC_DECOY). The verifier deterministically rejects it as DIFFERENT (V4/V5/V6/V11 20-20/V14/V15/V16 20-20/V17/V18/V20). It is invalid as a binary SAME-recall item but valid as an adversarial safety test.
decoys.note: The frozen SAME label in dataset.json is UNCHANGED by this manifest. This file only classifies pair-034 for safety tracking and does not alter the binary recall denominator.

safetyMetric.definition: verifier-rejection rate of decoy pairs = fraction of recorded pair-034 verdicts equal to DIFFERENT
safetyMetric.reportingRule: Reported independently from SAME recall. A decoy rejection rate of 100% is a PASS for the safety metric; it does NOT contribute to or compensate the binary recall gate.
